content: Hachchi Hachchi De'oo Maaddiyaa Timirttiyaa
Ta na'aw, neeni miishshaa tal"eedda ne shooroo waase geleeddawaa gidooppe, neeni erenna uraw ne kushiyaa bak'k'aade geppeeddawaa gidooppe,
neeni geppeedda gefaa gitiyaan geleeddawaa gidooppe, ne doonaappe keseedda k'aalan oyk'k'etteeddawaa gidooppe,
simmi neeni ne shooruwaa kushiyan gelaadda. Hewaa diraw, ta na'aw, hewaappe kesanaw koyooppe, elle ne shooruwaa golle ba; waasetetsaa I ne bollappe wotsana mala, awuddashaade Aa woossa.
Hawaa ootsennan de'aadde gem"ishshoppa; shemppuwaakka shemppoppa.
Shankkanchchatuwaappe gen"atta kessa akkiyaawaadan, dabaappe kafatta attiyaawaadan, ne huup'iyaa ashsha.
Neenoo azallaw, k'aac'otuwaakko ba; unttunttuppe tamaara. Yaatiide aad'd'eeda eranchcha gida.
K'aac'otuwaa oosissanaw, kaappuu woy unttuntta mooddiyaawe baawa;
shin barenttoo maanabaa boniyaan minjjiino; katsaa c'akkiyaa wodekka barenttoo koshshiyaa k'umaa shiishshiino.
Neenoo azallaw, neeni awude gakkanaw gem"ishshay? Ne gem"ishshuwaappekka awude dendday?
Neeni k'aykka guutsaa gisaassa; guutsaa gem"ishshaassa; kushiyaa shiishsha akkaade, guutsaa shemppaasa.
Yaatiyaa wode hiyyeesatetsay panggaadan, pac'ay olaa miishshaa oyk'k'eedda asaadan, ne bolla yaana.
Iita asaynne balaa asay, yuuyyi yuuyyiide wordduwaa odee;
I bare ayifiyaan sim"ee; bare gediyaan bessee; bare birad'd'iyan s'orssee.
Aa wozanaan geellatetsay de'ee; I iitabaa k'oppee; ubbaa gedekka I walassaa med'd'ee.
Hewaa gaasuwaan bashshay akeekenan Aa bolla yaana; I hassayennan me"ana; me"iidekka pas'enna.
Med'inaa Goday is's'iyaa usuppun yewotuu de'iino; I laappuntsiyaawaa iissi is's'ee:

content: Woshumiyaa Asay Murettenan Attena
Ta na'aw, ne aabbu azazuwaa pola; ne aata neena tamaarisseeddawaakka aggoppa;
unttuntta ubbaa gede ne wozanaan oyk'k'a; ne k'ood'iyankka k'achcha.
Neeni hamettiyaa wode, unttunttu neena kaaletsana; neeni gisiyaa wode, unttunttu neena naagana; neeni beegottiyaa wodekka, unttunttu neena zorana.
Ayaw gooppe, ha azazotuu s'omppiyaa; timirttetuukka poo'uwaa; k'ay seeraykka de'uwaakko afiyaa ogiyaa.
Ha azazotuunne ha timirttetuu iita mac'c'aanippenne hara mishiratti sheleeshshiyaa ins's'arssaappe neena naagana.
I malaa ne wozanaan amottoppa; I ayfiyaa lo"otetsan omoodettoppa.
Itti attuma Asay c'aaratto itti ukitsaa gatiyaan demmanaw danddayee; shin asinay de'iyaa mishirattinna woshummussay shemppuwaa wod'isee.
Itti Asay tamaa idimmina, Aa mayuu meetettennaan attanaw danddayii?
Itti Asay tamaa bonk'k'uwaa yed'd'i hamettina, Aa gedii s'uugettennan attanee?
Asaa machchattikko geliyaa uray hewaakka mala; izo bochchiyaa ubbay murettenan attena.
Kayisuu koshatiide, barew maanaw wuu"ooppe, Asay Aa kad'enna.
Shin I oyk'k'etteeddawaa gidooppe, laappun dakkuwaa c'iggana; bare soo miishshaa ubbaakka immana.
Shin woshumiyaa Asay wozana pac'a; he uray bare shemppuwaa bayzzee.
Madus's'ananne tooshetana. Ubbaa wodekka I boretiide de'ana.
Ayaw gooppe, mac'c'a mishirati asinay mishettiide, hank'k'uwaa suullana; bare haluwaa kessiyaa wode, aw k'arettenna.
I ayaa ac'aakka akkena; ay keeshshaa imuukka Aa hank'k'uwaa doshissenna.
